parameters.content:
## 2 · WhatsApp replies
Inbound message → find the contact → **Decide next step** (state machine) → save to HubSpot → send the next question, or hand off: pick consultant → owner + task → alert consultant → thank prospect.

**Exercises:** N3 re-ask then hand off · N4 Click-to-WhatsApp unknown sender.

  graphUrl: 'http://localhost:4010/meta/v21.0',
  waUrl: 'http://localhost:4010/whatsapp/v21.0',

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'phone', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.from }] }], properties: ['firstname','city','fib_qual_step','fib_wa_opt_out','fib_budget_lakh','fib_timeline_months','fib_lead_score','fib_last_wa_message_id'], limit: 1 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $node["Decide next step"].json.phone, ...$node["Decide next step"].json.message }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'hs_lead_status', operator: 'IN', values: ['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS'] }] }], properties: ['hubspot_owner_id'], limit: 200 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hubspot_owner_id: $json.ownerId, hs_lead_status: 'OPEN', fib_qual_step: 'handed_off', lifecyclestage: ['hot','warm'].includes($json.score) ? 'salesqualifiedlead' : 'marketingqualifiedlead' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_timestamp: $node["Pick consultant"].json.due, hs_task_subject: '[' + $node["Pick consultant"].json.score.toUpperCase() + '] Contact ' + ($node["Pick consultant"].json.contact.firstname || 'new lead'), hs_task_body: $node["Pick consultant"].json.summary, hs_task_status: 'NOT_STARTED', hs_task_priority: 'HIGH', hubspot_owner_id: $node["Pick consultant"].json.ownerId }, associations: [{ to: { id: $node["Pick consultant"].json.contactId }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 204 }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $node["Pick consultant"].json.consultant.phone, type: 'template', template: { name: 'consultant_new_lead', language: { code: 'en' }, components: [{ type: 'body', parameters: [$node["Pick consultant"].json.consultant.name, $node["Pick consultant"].json.contact.firstname || 'New lead', $node["Pick consultant"].json.score, $node["Pick consultant"].json.summary].map(t => ({ type: 'text', text: String(t) })) }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $node["Pick consultant"].json.phone, type: 'text', text: { body: 'Thank you! ' + $node["Pick consultant"].json.consultant.name + ' from our franchise team will contact you shortly.' } }) }}
